about.title: About us
about.label: about us
about.heroTitle: We design and build environments people are glad to live in.
about.heroText: Chawni is an architecture, engineering, interior and construction practice based in Sylhet, Bangladesh.
about.photoAlt: The Chawni studio, with its sculpted brick feature wall
about.storyTitle: Architecture, structure and interiors under one roof.
about.storyP1: Chawni is a small studio in Sylhet that designs buildings and the spaces inside them. Our team brings together architects, civil engineers, a graphic designer and a technologist, so a project can be drawn, engineered and built by people who talk to each other.
about.storyP2: Our portfolio runs from family homes and residential buildings to hotels, offices, learning centres and a mosque. The principle is the same each time: plan carefully, design with care, engineer properly and build as drawn.
about.missionText: To deliver well-designed, soundly engineered and honestly built environments, on time and with respect for the people who use them.
about.visionText: To be the practice that clients trust first for buildings that last and communities that thrive.
about.leadershipTitle: The people who lead the work
